summary: Phase 4 meets the task intent and the verification gate passes on this host (independently re-run, not just trusted from FEAT findings). The React SPA under top-level ui/ is a self-contained, thin presentation layer over the existing checkout-api: Vite + TS + React 18 with pinned deps and a committed package-lock.json, ui/ is NOT a uv workspace member (root pyproject.toml untouched), and the only backend code change is the additive env-driven CORSMiddleware on checkout-api with no decision-behavior change (confirmed: git diff shows only checkout_api/main.py + its test as backend source edits). I ran `uv run pytest services/checkout-api` = 16 passed (14 prior + 2 new CORS tests: GET header-present and OPTIONS preflight). In ui/ I ran npm ci + lint (clean) + test (24 vitest/RTL tests across 6 files pass, covering banner color mapping APPROVE/CHALLENGE/DECLINE, AgentCards populated AND empty, scenario payloads, and fetch-error state) + build (produces dist/index.html). The five scenario bodies mirror scripts/demo.py exactly (merchant_id mrc_demo, currency INR, context ip/user_agent/device_fingerprint, tok_<name>, idem_demo_<name> with a documented re-run nonce suffix); the UI POSTs then polls GET /v1/transactions/{id} tolerating 404/empty/partial, and the decision banner maps colors correctly. The multi-stage ui/Dockerfile (node:20-alpine npm ci && build -> nginx:alpine, SPA history fallback, EXPOSE 80) is wired additively into deploy/docker-compose.yml as demo-ui; `docker compose config` is valid and publishes 8090:80 and the compose diff is only the added block. Local run mode is complete and additive: start-local.sh/stop-local.sh (both parse, executable), .env.local.example (localhost overrides incl. KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP=localhost:19092 and every *_URL per the port map), Makefile up-local/down-local in help and .PHONY, and .gitignore entries (logs/ run/ .env.local ui/node_modules ui/dist all git-ignored). start-local launches exactly the 14 services on the specified ports overriding only the uvicorn --port CLI arg, plus the Vite dev server on 5173; stop-local is a clean no-op with no pid files and tears down infra only with --all/-v. The all-Docker path is unchanged apart from the single additive start.sh summary line and the DEMO-WALKTHROUGH.md/README.md references; .env.example and docs/01-07 are untouched. No blocking concerns.
